purpose: Active durable decisions only. Replace obsolete entries; do not append a history.

decisions.decision: Persistent Friends connects people across separate Homes through explicit recommendations, shared watchlists and watch-party invitations. Each participant retains independent media authorization. Friendship is not Home membership, library sharing or device-management authority. No automatic private taste, history, learning or credential export; only deliberately shared social content crosses Homes. Require invitation acceptance, removal/block/revocation and parent-authorized child participation.
decisions.rationale: Owner selected the own-media-access option on 2026-09-24. Existing remote-party and friend-installation work did not cover a persistent Friends layer. Record it in the existing watch-together feature group; old party evidence is not proof of this new scope.

decisions.decision: One shared Kotlin engine and Compose UI serve standalone Windows, Linux, Android phone/tablet and TV, with narrow native platform adapters. This supersedes separate C# Windows presentation. Desktop bundles its runtime without browser rendering. Only iOS may use browser/PWA presentation. Books is absent on TV. All targets share resumable identity, atmosphere, guidance, taste, source and optional Home onboarding. The HP has a visible interface by default; TV uses lightweight gradients and high-contrast stationary focus.
decisions.rationale: Owner approved the unified native completion plan on 2026-09-23. Equivalent standalone products share behavior and implementation, not identical executable bytes. Existing web launchers and separate Android subsets remain migration gaps, not acceptance evidence.

decisions.decision: Use actual learned 512D Float32 production embeddings, with versioned provenance and quality evaluation; do not substitute hashes, padded fixtures or regex and claim semantic learning. Algorithm updates must be valid: Sherman-Morrison applies to the relevant inverse-matrix update, not all embeddings. Keep fallbacks explicit and verify persistence, profile isolation and end-to-end model use.
decisions.rationale: Owner requires real ML throughout the neural architecture. Dimensions, coordinator registration and mathematical vocabulary alone are not model evidence. Named ML skills were not located; concrete requirements persist in repository instructions instead.

decisions.decision: Release acceptance requires physical tests on the owner's Windows workstation at 192.168.1.214, Onn TV at 192.168.1.95:5555, Galaxy Z Fold serial R5GL64PC0CF, and HP Ubuntu 26.04.1 appliance at 192.168.1.234. Verify live identities and resources; source/unit/simulation checks alone do not establish completion.
decisions.rationale: Authenticated 2026-09-23 inventory found Windows .214 with 15.8 GiB RAM, Onn TV using a 32-bit Android ABI, and HP Ubuntu with about 3.2 GiB RAM and a Cage Wayland kiosk. Fold was previously USB-authorized but is currently disconnected. Non-destructive isolated testing is allowed; destructive targets need exact authorization and old HP state must not enter the final installation.

decisions.decision: ReelOS is a calm, art-led personal cinema and books experience, not a dashboard.
decisions.rationale: Personal taste, artwork, a favorite-color atmosphere, and restrained motion carry its character while navigation stays predictable.

decisions.decision: Preserve the approved Home composition, falling artwork, setup breathing glow, taste bubbles, and Family direction; use Home, never Room.
decisions.rationale: These are the established visual anchors. New screens should extend them instead of restarting the design.

decisions.decision: Design touch- and TV-first with obvious stationary controls, clear exit/back paths, and no redundant page headers or decorative AI symbols.
decisions.rationale: The interface must feel magical without becoming hard to navigate or relying on hidden gestures.

decisions.decision: Each profile owns taste, appearance, saves, history, language, and reading progress. Household presence is separate from identity; children require enforced exit protection.
decisions.rationale: Personalization must not leak private history, and child controls cannot be cosmetic.

decisions.decision: Like, Love, Cozy, Dismiss, and Less like this are distinct and reversible. Dismiss means no opinion, not dislike. Family’s More of this in their world accepts parent-suggested titles or qualities as separate, attributed suggestions, not child preferences or policy changes. Gentle exposure preserves favorites and backs off after dismissals; include a Watch with me collection. Implement with the shared taste engine after current playback work.
decisions.rationale: Taste calibration should remain pleasant and truthful rather than turning uncertainty into negative preference.

decisions.decision: Public-domain and personal media are complete default sources. The core exposes a neutral Media source adapter contract and contains no named debrid provider or private source preset. Named provider adapters and owner indexers ship only in separately signed private setup packs; credentials are always entered per home.
decisions.rationale: Keep one capable extensible core while separating private household configuration, protecting credentials, and avoiding provider-specific public product language.

decisions.decision: Validated owner-configured source/provider playback is normal optional functionality, not blanket beta. Personal/public-domain remains default. Installing or enabling an adapter is not source authority; validate credentials and bytes. Disable revokes that source without deleting originals. Unverified official handoffs and experiments remain individually gated; no protected browser-stream capture.
decisions.rationale: Owner explicitly selected Separate them and approved the detailed execution plan on 2026-09-23, superseding blanket provider beta. Incomplete adapters stay honest without hiding validated functionality. No implicit paid purchase or signing replacement.

decisions.decision: The approved friend-ready milestone includes every one of the 19 active feature groups and 47 interface requirements, native on Windows/Linux/Android/TV, with Books excluded on TV. Preserve background channels with isolated history and Tune In, overnight preparation, household compute, in-flight analysis, predictive cache, guidance, remote device policy and atmosphere. MacOS, live TV/sports and fleet administration remain parked. Hardware-specific unsupported integrations require explicit capability contracts; ordinary missing journeys cannot be relabeled unavailable. Shadow models remain non-authoritative until qualified.
decisions.rationale: The 2026-09-23 full completion plan supersedes narrower Day-0 deferrals. Independent UI/UX and physical acceptance are release gates; one source revision, native packages, signing, clean-user installation and update/recovery evidence precede friend distribution.

decisions.decision: An authorized household manager can use their phone or any other ReelOS node to select another household computer or device and change its media-storage budget and background-preparation preferences. Controls identify the target device and display its acknowledged settings and usage.
decisions.rationale: The owner explicitly confirmed remote storage management on 2026-09-23. Cross-device targeting is intentional. Authorization checks the acting person's household authority; pairing alone must not grant a child or guest management access. The target device retains measured free-space, playback, thermal and protected-original safeguards. Offline changes remain pending until acknowledged, never falsely applied.

decisions.decision: Discovery may learn from or display catalog metadata that is not available, but playable, save, request, and No idea outcomes must reflect verified access. UI never fabricates service success.
decisions.rationale: Users can train taste on Batman without being told they can play or add Batman when their sources do not provide it.

decisions.decision: ReelOS is one end-to-end local neural system, not an ARR stack, Jellyfin fork, or conventional media manager with optional AI features. Product domains share a local event and feature spine through guarded specialists and a coordinator; deterministic policy remains authoritative.
decisions.rationale: This prevents agents and implementations from rebuilding retired orchestration or treating the neural hierarchy as decoration. Registered, connected, fallback, and shadow capabilities must remain visibly distinct.

decisions.decision: Learning remains local with no exports beyond the Home, including anonymous taste profiles. The former cross-home exchange is retired in favor of authorized within-Home matching. Models run in network-isolated workers with no credentials; separate constrained brokers handle authorized Home sync and media/update traffic. Deterministic policy controls access, family safety, resources and destructive actions.
decisions.rationale: Owner selected no learning exports and approved this privacy boundary on 2026-09-23. Test actual egress isolation; do not equate a privacy label with isolation or describe internet-connected devices as physically air-gapped. Private analysis must not escape via diagnostics.

decisions.decision: Prefer compatible originals/existing renditions and remux/audio-only paths; prepare necessary device-compatible video renditions ahead of demand within the household storage-slider budget. Live video transcoding is a measured, yielding last resort.
decisions.rationale: Idle time removes the real-time deadline; RAM does not replace codec compute. Private local learning ranks likely titles and device/network scenarios, while deterministic rules enforce resource limits, source access, provider backoff, and playback priority. Avoid every-format duplication, repeated downloads, and cascaded lossy encodes. Preserve personal originals and pinned media; evict only disposable managed renditions. Validate outputs before publishing readiness. This is required work, not verified implementation.

decisions.decision: Reuse authorized cached media for a versioned local analysis pass: timestamped transcripts/subtitle candidates, spoiler-bounded summaries, audio characteristics, and family-content annotations. Reuse valid results before fetching media or rerunning inference; per-title analysis does not require retraining a model.
decisions.rationale: One authorized source supports preparation and companion features without repeated provider traffic. Jobs yield to playback and respect storage/network/provider budgets. No analysis or learning exports beyond the Home. Match evidence to exact edition/audio/timebase; uncertainty must not relax parent policy. In-flight sampled analysis is distinct from rendition compression.

decisions.decision: Playback, filtering, PIN enforcement, installation, learning, and synchronization are described as operational only after their backing service is verified. Preview adapters remain visibly distinct.
decisions.rationale: The product must be ambitious without misrepresenting the state of its backend.

decisions.decision: Validate four native targets in isolated state, then install the signed candidate and rehearse clean friend setup. Obsolete ReelOS application state is disposable after exact app/package targets are identified; do not import old HP state. Never wipe OS, networking, unrelated files or signing identity. Subsequent updates preserve new installation state.
decisions.rationale: The owner approved four-device feasibility and debugging in the 2026-09-23 plan, superseding the former final-candidate-only restriction. This does not authorize destructive cleanup or replacing the existing signing identity.

decisions.decision: Legacy routes and components remain until a route-by-route replacement and retirement check exists; do not delete them based on appearance alone.
decisions.rationale: The recovered codebase contains overlapping generations. Safe removal requires evidence, not a broad rewrite.
